name.description: Name is what the member types after the slash: a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits and dashes, at most 24, none of the chat's own.

words.description: Words say what the command asks, as one line of the palette.

message.description: Message is the text the chat sends for /name; the chat's own commands have none.

items.description: Command is one command: a name and the message it sends.

commands.description: Commands are the commands the chat offers after its own /compact and /new.

title: factory/commands
description: Commands is commands.yaml: the chat's commands.
